description: One knob driving sixteen outputs at once, each carrying the same movement mapped onto a different voltage span, with a seventeenth output carrying it unchanged

params.text: Sets the value all the outputs are derived from, -10V to 10V; a cable in the input jack takes this knob over and moves it
Sets the span used by the four outputs marked R, 0 to 10V
Attenuverts the range CV before it is added to the range knob
Scales the input before it reaches the master value, -2 to 2 times
Shifts the input after the gain and before the master value, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: Replaces the master knob, through the gain and offset trimmers, and clamped to -10 to 10V; the knob follows what arrives here
Changes the span used by the four outputs marked R, added to the range knob through its attenuverter

outputs.text: Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 0 to 1V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 0 to 5V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 0 to 10V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 0V rising to the range setting
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto -1 to 1V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto -5 to 5V
Carries the master value unchanged, -10 to 10V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto the range setting negated, rising to the range setting
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 1V falling to -1V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 5V falling to -5V, despite the maker's tooltip naming it the other way round
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 10V falling to -10V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto the range setting falling to its negative
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 1V falling to 0V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 5V falling to 0V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto 10V falling to 0V
Maps the master value's -10 to 10V travel onto the range setting falling to 0V

notes: with nothing patched the module is a knob with seventeen scaled copies of itself; patching the input jack hands control to the cable and the knob follows it

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
